notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Stabilizing the End
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We recently took all of Dex' old games over to the Duality Beyond Studios account. While Sirius Online is being taken off sale completely, we decided to take up the opportunity to give AOTFA some last points of love before we move on to our newer games.

Patch 1.1 thus, contains a few Engine updates to allow the game running with more than 1.5GB RAM and not crash in unsupported resolutions. 

We also reduced the game's price to 1,99$, to reflect the age and state of this game.

Feel free to join the Discord and take a look at our newest endeavours: beyond.frontiers and TinyDACHI

- the DualityBeyond Team

notes.title: The Road to 1.0.6: What to come, what to expect!
notes.content:
Hello Commanders!

it has been a few weeks since the last update and I want to give you a small update on whats been happening here at worldofdex.de. Ever since the initial Launch and #IndieSelect ended, I've been collecting feedback for a bigger update to come - 1.0.6. A lot is here to change, a bit is here to stay, and a huge chunk I'm going to explain - so grab a beer, sit back and enjoy!

UI/UX and Sound

A lot of feedback was about the volume levels, the unintuitive UI and User Experience (UX), so I am currently looking for a UI Artist on commission basis to iron out my terrible developer art, and work together to make the first few minutes easy and bearable. The general feel of a UI should be more welcoming instead of confusing.

Sound also was an often requested change. As a patron you get exclusive access to a new game branch, so you can see the changes first, and the "Futurist"-Branch soon gets a new Audio Control Interface, where you can control individual channels, from ANGEL to the exceptional background music.

Universe Size and Persistance

With nine systems in total, the AotFA-Cluster was too small to allow extensive gameplay - this is being fixed with 1.0.6, which lays groundwork for some pretty major changes. The Cluster is getting expanded to 29 Systems and starts getting dynamic background simulation. This means explored sectors stay explored, conquered sectors stay conquered (for a while until war breaks out again) and the persistence lays the groundwork for a future feature: player owned structures.

The expansion of the universe also adds more unique opportunities to explorers and, for the first time, traders. The upcoming updates 1.0.6 allows you to buy and sell wares at stations across the universe - with a dynamic supply and demand system to determine resource pricing and demand.

AI Upgrades / Rewrite

The Game AI, T.O.A.St. or long "Tactical Oriented Artificial STupidity", is a self-written module that controls all aspects of the AI and had been updated to version 9.0 for the Launch of AotFA. Now it is time to iron out crucial flaws with T.O.A.St. and completely rewrite the mechanics. Currently TOASt goes through the list of ships in the system by number, and since the player is kept as number 0 in the location database, you are always the prime target for all hostile AI in system. A relic from Sirius Online times, where the AI lies dormant when far away and only checks when a player is near them. 

The T.O.A.St. Update will remove dependencies of distance as well as the substates of a role, so each ai type will get its own controller, being able to control types individually - and with that, more efficient and less convoluted. 

Twitch Integration

The System to connect to Twitch, Privacy Ensuring Network Interfacing System (P.E.N... well, imagine the rest of it yourself. We Devs like to chuckle once in a while ;) )is pretty much done, but I'd like to update the visuals and performance of the backend to allow more varied events and interactions, like story decisions, faction invasions and so on..

Support the Development of AotFA, Night of the Sandwich and more

You are now able to support the long term development of the game for a small monthly contribution and get lots of extra perks! Join the Patreon-Campaign and help us make more and better games!

Feel free to join the Community Discord here:

AOTFA Discord

Regards, Dex

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5: Derelict Ships, Minefields, New Menu, Starmap, and so, so much more...
notes.content:
Hello Agents!

Patch 1.0.5 is finally here after this long delay. Many things have changed and let us start with the much awaited patch notes!

Following things have been done:


 New Weapon Scaling - Shield/Armor and Long Range Weapons Main Menu and Character Creation ahs been completely redone
 Updated Damage for all NPCs
 Updated T.O.A.St. to ahve slightly better Collision Avoidance
 Added Starmap Functionality with Shift+B
 Another Update to Loot Timing and strength
 ANGEL is back and replaces BRIAN
 Tutorial is now completely overhauled and should be way more pleasant to the eyes and better playable.
 New Randomized Racetrack in the Tutorial System
 Lost Ships can now appear and be found in star systems. Search for a blue Ping on the scanner.
 Scanner now pitches Differently depending on rarity. Higher Pitch = Rarer item.
 Minefields can now appear in Star Systems.
 Story Pacing has been changed slightly with ANGEL.
 NPCs now talk less gibberish.


Feel free to join the Community Discord here:

AOTFA Discord

Next Update - 1.0.6

Regards, Dex

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 is coming next week!
notes.content:
Hello Commanders!

After the quick succession of patches last week I took some time to go for the things mentioned in the recent review and the constructive criticism, to improve on what is in and what can be made better.

I am still hard working on things like derelict ships, better Story handling and an all new tutorial with subtitles, as well as usable menus.

This was, as you know the old start menu:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34440821/8f44f0c1608833a3cf97863a224ab06d822a9323.jpg

In 1.0.5, it is replaced with this, a far superior, more readable and usable version.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34440821/09ac23f878feb4f9f10e4494d5308706c167ee87.png

There are more changes coming along, like an automatic loot tractor beam, removal of manual mining, hidden treasures, minefields that can be weaponized, radiation zones, Epstein Jumpdrive Fields, hazardous zones. I hope I can deliver this Patch somewhere between tuesday and thursday and hope you will definitely like it :)

Regards,

Dex
